row.team_price_text: Commercial: Contact Sales (Starter is free, self-hosted, up to 50 users)
row.evidence: Rocket.Chat's plans page and documentation describe SSO, LDAP, SAML 2.0 and AD integration, and LDAP background sync that imports new users, but no Rocket.Chat page documents a SCIM endpoint.
row.notes: Status changed from gated to none (by absence, medium confidence). June's claim that Enterprise 'supports SCIM via directory group mapping' has no first-party source: the docs index (docs.rocket.chat/llms.txt), the developer API index (developer.rocket.chat/llms.txt) and the plans page contain no SCIM pages. Automated provisioning is via LDAP/AD background sync (premium setting that imports new users) or SAML/OIDC sign-in; SAML needs a Premium plan from 9.0.0, while Starter is said to include SSO. Plans changed: the pricing URL now redirects to /plans, which lists Commercial, Government and Defense (Contact sales) plus free Starter (self-hosted, up to 50 users) and Community; Pro moved to legacy on April 29, 2026. June's '~$10+/u/mo' had no first-party source and is dropped. Name updated from 'Rocket.Chat Cloud' to Rocket.Chat; slug kept. The REST Users API (create, update, setActiveStatus, delete) is documented for all workspaces.

plans.name: Starter
plans.price_text: Free, self-managed and self-hosted, up to 50 users

scim.notes: Not documented: the authentication overview lists LDAP, SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect, iframe and CAS, no SCIM. scim plan flags are false by absence across the docs index.

user_api.notes: Base URL pattern is the workspace host plus /api/v1 as used in the endpoint paths. Plan: the Users API is documented without a plan gate.

auth.notes: Requests carry X-Auth-Token and X-User-Id headers; access is governed by role permissions such as create-user and delete-user.

webhooks_user_events.notes: Apps-Engine 'Users - Event Interfaces' exist for in-workspace apps; no outbound user-event webhook confirmed.

audit_log_api.notes: Audit Messages / Audit Rooms endpoints exist; plan not checked.

okta.notes: okta.com/integrations/rocket-chat/ returned 404; Rocket.Chat documents Okta via OIDC.

entra.notes: Rocket.Chat documents a Microsoft Entra ID SAML setup example.

fallbacks.other_sync: LDAP / Active Directory background sync that imports new users and updates existing ones (premium setting)
fallbacks.notes: SAML creates new users on sign-in (role attribute applies to new users); SAML needs a Premium plan from 9.0.0.
